      "observations": [
        "All nine owned paths and all 361 diff lines were read. The patch adds Graph to the existing Exchange advanced-settings data transfer and panel branch, and adds graph to each changed hidefor list. The actual hideShowControls consumer splits comma-separated types and sets hidden on a match. This is a static control contract, not rendered visibility or accessibility validation.",
        "The original native preference lookup changes from hardcoded mail.ews.server.details.<hostname>. to mail.<type>.server.details.<hostname>.. Both the incoming-server property adapters and Rust interop factory pass the actual server type. Application/tenant values remain in the existing Exchange-shaped fields and interfaces; the patch does not rename their stored or public names.",
        "AuthenticationProvider gains server_type for both incoming and outgoing server receivers. The original OAuth2 credential branch propagates GetType or factory errors with ?, passes type and identifier to CreateOAuth2Details, then initializes the OAuth module. The incoming identifier is its hostname; the outgoing identifier comes from GetServerURI().GetHost. No token exchange or native ABI equivalence was tested.",
        "The Graph advanced panel remains gated by experimental.mail.ews.overrideOAuth.enabled, default false. The dialog copies controls only when their IDs are in serverSettings; its override handler disables the five original custom fields when unchecked. The caller copies values back and dispatches prefchange. No changed test is included in this landing.",
        "The fixed accepted implementation retains the protocol type but later adds username to the key and replaces credentials.rs with authentication_provider.rs. ForAccount calls a separate migration before selecting that later key. The bounded current test uses ewsAccount and directly asserts disabled/enabled controls and changed application/tenant values; it does not establish a Graph test result or original-phase coverage.",
        "Manual style checks kept JS shared-script bindings and exact DOM field names, Rust fallible receiver methods and early error propagation, C++ RefPtr/result ownership and IDL signature changes separate. The changed server_type comment is accurate. The historical ForTypeAndHostname summary still names only hostname, so it omits the new protocol discriminator; this is a local comment improvement, not a global naming rule. No assertion was added by the patch; inspected accepted EWS assertions have non-empty expected-behavior messages.",
        "The original primary identifies the missing Graph preference lookup; the retained collector is Parent, not a second A browser read. The full own review has zero inline or summary-history bodies. Its approval is conditional on a passing Try run; a later Try link is present, but no job result was read. The landing says ongoing or failed builds. Source adoption is the Graph UI/type propagation checked here, not proof of successful authorization or mochitest execution."
